description: Figure 6(a) is a pie chart summarizing the distribution of video types in the benchmark dataset, showing 14 slices (categories) with percentage labels printed inside each wedge and category names placed around the pie; there is no separate legend and no slice appears exploded or otherwise emphasized. The slices are labeled and colored as follows (approximate percentages as shown): People Blogs (orange, 17.2%), Entertainment (purple, 13.9%), Howto Style (green, 9.7%), Education (red, 8.7%), Sports (pink, 7.7%), Gaming (gray, 6.4%), Travel Events (teal, 4.9%), Comedy (light blue, 4.6%), Film Animation (dark purple, 4.6%), Science Technology (blue, 4.3%), News Politics (yellow, 4.3%), Pets Animals (greenish, 3.9%), Autos Vehicles (red, 4.8%), and Music (blue, 2.3%). The wedges appear arranged around the circle without an obvious monotonic ordering by size.
